[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
A collection of small mods that are really only useful to anyone curating a collection.
These are very small and provided with limited support. But feel free to ask for help...

All of these settings can be configured in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
As a curator, you should supply your own config.json with your modlist.

[b][size=4]INCLUDED MODS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[color=#f1c232][b][size=3]DISCORD BUTTON[/size][/b][size=1]ㅤ[/size][/color]
Adds a Discord button in the lower right hand corner of the main menu.
Disabled by default. Will move if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41623]Stardew Games Menu[/url] is present.

[b][color=#f1c232][size=3]CUSTOM WINDOW TITLE[/size][/color][/b][size=1][color=#f1c232]ㅤ[/color][/size]
Replaces the window title with a custom name.
Includes an option to hide the mod count.

[b][color=#f1c232][size=3]INCREASE WINDOW SIZE[/size][/color][/b][size=1][color=#f1c232]ㅤ[/color][/size]
Adds an icon in the upper right hand corner to resize the window.
By default it is 1920 by 1080. Clicking it again restores the window size.


[b][size=4]FREQUENTLY ANTICIPATED QUESTIONS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[quote][b]Q. [/b]How do I add a Discord URL?
[b]A. [/b]Create an invite to your server and place it in the link in your config file. It will accept any valid Discord server invite.[/quote][quote][b]Q. [/b]Can you link to websites other than Discord using the Discord button?
[b]A. [/b]No, and this will never change.[/quote][quote][b]Q. [/b]Can I use this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10939][b]Default Window Size[/b][/url]?
[b]A. [/b]Yes, but the "Increase Window Size" feature will disable itself if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10939][b]Default Window Size[/b][/url] is present.
You probably want to be using that mod anyway.[/quote]
[url=https://codeberg.org/dylanjames-xyz/SmallMods][b]Source Code[/b][/url]. Also see 'Mirrors'.
